==Dialogue==
:''"Ahai. I'm out here researching rain beetles for [[Prince Mehtu the Wise|Prince Mehtu]]. I've sent several reports back to the library but I've yet to hear anything. Frankly, I'm getting a little sad about the lack of feedback from my colleagues."''
